verdict.rationale: Baseten has a dedicated first-party 'Coding agents' doc describing Baseten Switch for connecting Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Pi, plus an agent-setup guide for installing a Baseten skill/MCP server so agents can manage the workspace, and documented OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints for framework interoperability (e.g., LangChain ChatOpenAI). This directly matches the story of documented, first-party guides for plugging into coding agents and agent frameworks. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification that these agent integrations work smoothly in practice.
